|errata_history=This is a playtest image (19 August 2026), published before the set's official release (9 October 2026); the PC replaced it before release. The current text is [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 pre-release images are Playtest versions; the original printing is [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)]]. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Playtest''' (this page): Playtest image: PC card image of 19 August 2026<ref name="ht-nh-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9aaa4af/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/anewhope.gif anewhope.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9aaa4af 9aaa4af] (19 August 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. Destiny printed “4” (Virtual Set 27 preview). Text: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, take Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy < 4 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Original''' ([[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)]]): PC card image of 1 September 2026<ref name="ht-nh-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4f45e2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/anewhope.gif anewhope.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b4f45e2 b4f45e2] (1 September 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: the destiny number “4” becomes the Roman numeral “IV”. Game text unchanged. Text: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, take Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy < 4 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 5, file created 13 October 2026: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, take Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy &lt; 4 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)]] (published 1 September 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•New Hope”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The sheet's label reads “•New Hope”, not “A New Hope” as the card's title line prints; recorded as printed. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
